questions: This Apple TV+ series follows a secretive organization tracking Godzilla and other Titans across half a century, with Wyatt and Kurt Russell sharing one role — which Monsterverse show?
Monarch: Legacy of Monsters: American monster television series.
In which country is Virgin Atlantic based?
Virgin Atlantic: United Kingdom. Soon after changing the name to Virgin Atlantic Airways, Fields sold his shares in the company to Richard Branson in return for unlimited free travel.
Which of these was founded earliest?
Rashidun Caliphate (founded 632) is the earliest of the four.
Which of these four is the largest by area?
Montgomery, Alabama has the greatest area of the four (418 km2).
Fill in the blank: “____ (born 17 July 1970) is a Canadian writer, podcaster, far-right commentator and founder of the Proud Boys.”

Gavin McInnes (born 17 July 1970) is a Canadian writer, podcaster, far-right commentator and founder of the Proud Boys. During his time at Vice, McInnes was called a leading figure in the New York hipster subculture.
Born in 1953, this French football figure played ten years as a midfielder for Montpellier, his hometown club, before later becoming a manager — who is he?
Jean-Louis Gasset (9 December 1953 - 26 December 2025) was a French professional football manager and player.
Colored metallic blue on top and silvery below for camouflage, this genus of warm-blooded ocean fish includes the giant Atlantic bluefin and eight of the true tuna species — what genus is it?
Thunnus: Genus of fishes. Thunnus is a genus of ocean-dwelling, ray-finned bony fish from the mackerel family, Scombridae.
